entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a defect. The pulse reading is wildly inaccurate. I compared it to my old chest strap, and the data from this VeloBand is absolute garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing that. Inaccurate readings can be frustrating. I can connect you with our technical support team to troubleshoot the issue and verify the fault...
No, I really don't have time to go through a whole troubleshooting script. I've already tried resetting it. At this point, I just want money back. I'd like to process a refund.

I understand you'd prefer a direct refund. I see you received the item 34 days ago, which is just outside our standard window for returns without technical verification. Let me just place you on a brief hold while I confirm the policy for your specific product.
Okay. I'm a VIP member, if that helps. I've spent a lot with VeloFit. I get that policies exist, but surely we can work something out here. Maybe a partial credit?
Thank you for your patience, and yes, I do see your VIP status here. I appreciate you bringing that up. Please hold for just one moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I've pulled up our internal knowledge base, and I owe you an apology. It seems I was referencing a policy for a different product line. For the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, our return policy is actually 90 days from the delivery date.
Oh, 90 days? So I'm well within the window then.

That's correct. Since you're at day 34, you are absolutely eligible for a full return. I can process that for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on your account. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
That's fantastic. Thank you for double-checking that, Sarah. I appreciate it.

Of course, and again, my apologies for the initial confusion. As a thank you for your patience and for being a loyal VIP member, I've also added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for a future purchase. We do value your business.
Wow, that's very kind of you. Thank you so much. You've been a great help.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
